gem_guidance.text: Cowl of the Avatar is a very strongly itemized piece of gear that is both an improvement in sustain and in throughput compared to Light-Collar of the Incarnate . The gem bonus, which pairs well with Insightful Earthstorm Diamond , is just the cherry on top.

Belt of the Long Road is technically only a slight upgrade over Primal Mooncloth Belt , but the useful socket bonus, along with it allowing you to drop Tailoring in favour of a different profession make this a worthwhile pickup, especially if you are running the Insightful Earthstorm Diamond meta gem. Keep in mind that you should only swap once you have dropped the Mana Regen 5% set bonus, which is typically once you have 4 pieces of Avatar Raiment .

title: Priest Healing Best in Slot (BiS) Phase 2 Gear Guide - TBC Classic - Wowhead
